question.text: If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi></math> are non-singular matrices of order <math><mn>3</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo></math> such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>adj</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>adj</mi><mi>A</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> , then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>det</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mi>A</mi></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mi>det</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mi>B</mi></mfenced></math> is equal to (where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>det</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>M</mi><mo>)</mo></math> represents the determinant of matrix <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>M</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>adj</mi><mi>M</mi></math> represents the adjoint matrix of matrix <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>M</mi></math>)

solution.text:
A=adjB=adjadjA=AA
⇒A=A4⇒A=1⇒B=1
